name: Tag Team GX Premium Trainer Box

releases.name: Tag Team GX Premium Trainer Box

description.text: Premium Trainer Box TAG TEAM GX, released on 7 December 2018: 20 booster packs of Tag Bolt and 180 cards of 44 kinds for building decks, 23 Pokémon, 45 Trainers, 4 Special Energy and 108 basic Energy in a new design, the first Premium Trainer Box to include Pokémon. Among them is a Tapu Lele-GX with new artwork, whose Ability Wonder Tag suits almost any deck and is found in many decks that placed at tournaments. It also held acrylic damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, 64 matte sleeves found only in this box, a coin, a GX marker and a card box.
